decks.notes: This deck revolves around using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, supported by a variety of multicolored spells to trigger its ability and gain card advantage. The deck also features a few key planeswalkers and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and resilience. The mana base is designed to support the diverse range of colors needed for the deck's spells, with a mix of shock lands, check lands, and fetch lands to ensure consistency.

The Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells to pressure the opponent's life total. Utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency and power to the deck. By deploying threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Voldaren Thrillseeker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory. With a mix of creatures and spells, this deck seeks to outpace and outlast its opponents in the Pioneer format.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively cast Arclight Phoenixes from the graveyard using cards like Opt, Consider, and Treasure Cruise to fuel their recursion. Support cards like Spell Pierce and Fiery Impulse help control the board while Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder help disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of unique cards like Hall of Storm Giants and Ashiok, Dream Render provide additional value and options for winning the game. Ultimately, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of quick, efficient threats and disruptive spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on bringing out aggressive creatures quickly and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also has a strong removal package with Fatal Push, Go for the Throat, and Bonecrusher Giant. The key strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game, using efficient removal spells to clear the opponent's threats. The deck also has some high-powered finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out games.

This deck focuses on quickly playing Auras to buff up your creatures and overwhelm your opponent with aggressive attacks. Using Skrelv, Defector Mite and Ethereal Armor to boost your creatures' power, along with protection spells like Alpha Authority and Kaya's Ghostform, you can quickly establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional flexibility and consistency in your deck construction. By combining auras with aggressive creatures like Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice and Generous Visitor, this deck aims to take control of the game and pressure your opponent into submission.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize a fast and aggressive strategy by focusing on devotion to green, allowing for massive mana production with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa. The deck also includes powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to quickly overwhelm opponents. Supporting cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help to accelerate the deck's game plan, while Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection. By ramping up quickly and deploying threats efficiently, this deck aims to overpower opponents in the early turns of the game.

The key concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic, discard spells, and removal. The deck focuses on using cards like Thoughtseize and Censor to disrupt the opponent's hand, while utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with their threats on the board. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to generate card advantage and control the game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's dual-colored requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck utilizes strong black and red creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, along with disruption spells such as Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional value and synergy with the vampire theme of the deck. With a mix of hard-hitting creatures and targeted removal, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and resources through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also generating value from cards discarded with effects like Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue the opponent over time with powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while using cards like Mazemind Tome to draw into additional resources.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries by casting cheap spells such as Opt and Fiery Impulse, in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and put pressure on the opponent with continuous attacks. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Jwari Disruption to control the opponent's game plan. Treasure Cruise is used to reload the hand with more spells while Ledger Shredder helps to filter the deck. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and resourceful in its approach to win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and enchanting them to deal damage swiftly, leveraging Voldaren Epicure and Ensoul Artifact to apply pressure early in the game. The inclusion of Torch the Tower allows for removal of threats, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana flexibility. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of artifact creatures, efficient removal spells, and strategic enchantments to maintain a consistent tempo and aggression throughout the game.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly, playing a variety of green creatures, and generating devotion to green with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and powerful green creatures, while also utilizing the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. The deck includes cards like Cavalier of Thorns, Nissa, Vital Force, and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to maintain board presence and put pressure on the opponent. Overall, the strategy revolves around creating a strong green board presence and utilizing powerful effects to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful combo spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. It also includes various land tutors and card draw spells to search for the necessary pieces while protecting the combo with control elements like Archdruid's Charm and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on assembling the Lotus Field combo quickly by tutoring for the necessary lands and using cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field for extra mana. Cards like Strict Proctor and Bala Ged Recovery help protect the combo while ramping into powerful threats like Elder Gargaroth and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes some control elements with Archdruid's Charm and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned to interact with the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently combo off while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various support cards to gain a large amount of life and win the game with Aetherflux Reservoir. It includes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to find the necessary pieces quickly, while also utilizing cards like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition for protection and disruption. The deck aims to generate a significant amount of life through the combo pieces and other cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker, ultimately leading to victory through Aetherflux Reservoir's ability.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficient removal spells and hand disruption to control the game early on, while quickly deploying aggressive creatures to apply pressure and close out the game. It utilizes a mix of powerful cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to disrupt the opponent's plans and maintain a strong board presence. By combining disruptive elements with hard-hitting creatures like Voldaren Thrillseeker and Bloodtithe Harvester, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victories through a combination of early aggression and resource denial.
